name: AEON
summary: An industrial humanoid launched by Hexagon, a large measurement-technology company, at its Hexagon LIVE event in June 2025. AEON has 34 degrees of freedom, five-fingered hands, a battery-swap mechanism for continuous operation, and is built to fold in Hexagon's reality-capture and spatial-intelligence tech; Schaeffler and Pilatus are pilot partners.
notable: Battery hot-swap for non-stop operation; automotive and aerospace pilots
